card.fact_statement: Rodrigo Londoño criticized the ELN in a letter responding to statements made by Antonio García.
card.source_span: Rodrigo Londoño, former commander of the FARC-EP and leader of the Comunes party, criticized the ELN in a letter responding to the statements of Antonio García
